issues.description: Client-side feature tier check bypass: user tier is read directly from localStorage without server token verification
issues.suggestion: Validate subscription status and entitlements via signed JWT or backend session check before unlocking premium features.

issues.description: Floating point arithmetic used directly for subscription discount calculations leading to rounding inaccuracies
issues.suggestion: Store monetary amounts in cents/smallest currency unit as integers or use a dedicated decimal math library.

issues.description: Hardcoded subscription tier limits and plan IDs scattered across multiple conditional branches
issues.suggestion: Centralize plan configurations and feature limits into a strongly-typed PlanConfig record.

codeQuality.summary: Significant security vulnerability identified in client-side entitlement check alongside pricing precision concerns.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Zero test coverage for core subscription verification and tier expiration logic.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should accurately mark expired subscriptions as inactive", () => { const expiredSub = { expiresAt: Date.now() - 1000 }; expect(isSubActive(expiredSub)).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Discounts and promotional pricing calculation paths have no automated tests.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should correctly compute prorated discount without floating point error", () => { expect(computePrice(1999, 15)).toBe(1699); });

testCoverage.summary: New subscription module lacks dedicated unit tests for entitlement verification and billing math.

suggestions.description: Refactor deeply nested if-else ladders into Strategy / Configuration Map pattern for plan limits
suggestions.after: const PLAN_LIMITS: Record<PlanTier, PlanLimits> = { free: { maxTodos: 20 }, pro: { maxTodos: 1000 }, enterprise: { maxTodos: Infinity } }; return PLAN_LIMITS[plan];
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates branching complexity (cyclomatic complexity reduced from 9 to 1) and makes adding new tiers declarative.

suggestions.description: Extract feature entitlement validation into dedicated policy guard
suggestions.before: if (user.tier !== "pro" && feature === "tags") throw new Error("Upgrade required");
suggestions.benefits: Decouples UI component action logic from subscription business rules.

refactorings.summary: Replace procedural conditional chains with configuration-driven strategy objects to scale feature tiers cleanly.

recommendations.description: Never rely on client-side state (localStorage) for subscription tier gating. Verify user entitlements on the backend or validate signed cryptographic tokens.
Create dedicated unit test suite for src/subscription.ts covering expiration dates, renewal transitions, and billing math.
Refactor tier limit checks from nested conditional statements into a declarative Strategy pattern.
